name: mn.unegui/listings
title: Unegui.mn classifieds
description: Search classified listings on Unegui.mn (Mongolia) and open listing details.

tools.name: search_adverts
tools.description: Search listings on the marketplace. Results never include seller contacts. Show a listing only with the photos that search_adverts or get_advert returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources. If it has no photo, show no image. New developments (projects that developers sell off-plan or newly built) are a separate catalog: use search_new_buildings for them.

location.description: City or district to search in, by name: where the listings are, not the user's location.
location.title: Location

attributes.description: Category filters from get_category_filters: {key: value} for select, {key: [values]} for multiselect, {key + '_min' / key + '_max': number} for range.
attributes.title: Attributes

page_token.description: next_page_token of the previous result, same filters.
page_token.title: Page Token

language.description: Language of listing texts: one of mn. Default mn.
language.title: Language

tools.name: get_advert
tools.description: Listing details: description, attributes, photos, seller. No contacts: use reveal_contact. Show a listing only with the photos that search_adverts or get_advert returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources. If it has no photo, show no image.

advert_id.description: advert_id from search_adverts, or a listing url.
advert_id.title: Advert Id

language.description: Language of listing texts: one of mn. Default mn.
language.title: Language

tools.name: reveal_contact
tools.description: Seller's phone, WhatsApp or chat link. Call only when the user asks to contact the seller. Call it for the one listing the user asked to contact; never reveal contacts for several listings at once or to compile a list of contacts.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Marketplace categories, one level at a time. Use category_id in search_adverts. New developments (projects that developers sell off-plan or newly built) are a separate catalog: use search_new_buildings for them.

language.description: Language of listing texts: one of mn. Default mn.
language.title: Language

tools.name: get_category_filters
tools.description: Filters available in a category (brand, model, year, storage...) for search_adverts.attributes.

language.description: Language of listing texts: one of mn. Default mn.
language.title: Language

tools.name: search_new_buildings
tools.description: Search new developments: residential projects that developers sell off-plan or newly built, with units on sale and their prices. Use it whenever the user asks for new developments, new builds or developer projects; on the sites the catalog is called «New Developments», «Νέα Έργα», «Новостройки», «Шинэ орон сууц». Results never include contacts. Show a project only with the photos that search_new_buildings or get_new_building returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources.

query.description: Project or developer name, or a word from the description, matched as one substring. Leave it empty for bedrooms, price or city: use filters, price_min / price_max and location.
query.title: Query

location.description: City or district to search in, by name: where the projects are, not the user's location.
location.title: Location

filters.description: Catalog filters from `filters` of a previous result: {key: value} for select, {key: [values]} for multiselect, e.g. {'bedrooms': ['2', '3']}; {key + '_min' / key + '_max': number} for range.
filters.title: Filters

page_token.description: next_page_token of the previous result, same filters.
page_token.title: Page Token

language.description: Language of listing texts: one of mn. Default mn.
language.title: Language

tools.name: get_new_building
tools.description: New development details: description, units on sale with prices, amenities, distances, photos. No contacts: use reveal_developer_contact. Show a project only with the photos that search_new_buildings or get_new_building returned for it; never illustrate it with images from image search or other sources.

new_building_id.description: new_building_id from search_new_buildings, or a project url.
new_building_id.title: New Building Id

language.description: Language of listing texts: one of mn. Default mn.
language.title: Language

tools.name: reveal_developer_contact
tools.description: Sales contacts of a new development: the developer's sales team and agencies that sell it, each with its role. Call only when the user asks to contact them. Call it for the one project the user asked to contact; never reveal contacts for several projects at once or to compile a list of contacts.
